args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate was 0.18 and service was unhealthy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; service is now on v2.3.0.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0", describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms `checkout-api` is now on v2.3.0, healthy in all regions, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version.
